title: Uttho meri jaan ali akber uttho
body:
Uttho meri jaan ali akber uttho-2
Haye Ali Akber.
Sooz.
Aalame peeri me daaghe naujawan dil me liye
Teh kiye bekas pidar ne kaise kaise marhale
Aur bahattar martaba girte rahe uth te rahe
Dast me pahunche shahe mazloom ye kehte hue
Uth tho meri jaan ali akbar utho
Uthke zara baap ka haal to dekho -2
1) Lut gaya ek dopahar hi me mera sara chaman,
Subha se laashe utha kar thak gaya hun jaane mana,
Sath mera cchod kar tum bhi gaye tashnadhan,
Bhook se tharra raha hai ab mera zakhmi badan,
Khushk hai zubaan ali akbar utho.
Utke Zara baap ka haal tu Dekho,
Uth tho meri jaan ali akbar utho
2) Kyun taras meri zaeefi par nahi khata jahan,
Gir raha hun har qadam par alhafeez-o-allama,
Meri aankhon se lahu ke ashq hote hain rawaan,
Kuch nazar ata nahi maqtal me phaila hai dhuaan,
Sote ho kahan ali akbar utho.
Utke Zara baap ka haal tu Dekho,
Uth tho meri jaan ali akbar utho
3) Jab bhi naana ki ziyarat ka mujhe ata khayal,
dekh leta tha mai jee bhar kar tumhe yusuf jamal,
Haye mujhse maut ne cheena hai tumko mere laal,
Ho gaya rangeen tumhare khoon se daste khital,
Haye naujawan ali akbar utho.
Utke Zara baap ka haal tu Dekho,
Uth tho meri jaan ali akbar utho
4) Jisne aththaraah baras paala hai tumko mere laal,
Dekh lo ek baar tum khaime me akar uska haal,
Teen din ki bhook aur tashna labi se hai nidhaal,
Bin tumhare uska ab ho jayega jeena muhaal,
Ro rahi hai maa ali akbar utho.
Utke Zara baap ka haal tu Dekho,
Uttho meri jaan ali akber uttho-2
5) Dard seene me agar ho to ali ka naam lo,
Apne boodhe baap ka ye dukh bhara payghaam lo,
Utho mere laal ab himmat se thoda kaam lo,
Sar mera chakra raha hai baazuon ko thaam lo,
Tashna lab jawan ali akbar utho.
Utke Zara baap ka haal tu Dekho,
Uttho meri jaan ali akber uttho-2
6) Tha MUQARRIB ki NAZAR me hashr ka manzar MUJEEB,
Peet ti thi apna seena zainabe muztar mujeeb,
Gir padin behosh hokar maadare akbar Mujeeb,
Bar sare maqtal shahe mazool ke lab par mujeeb,
Thi yahi fughaan ali akbar utho.
Utke Zara baap ka haal tu Dekho,
Uttho meri jaan ali akber uttho-2
